_what: MASTER MIND INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION of the two decisive arms, 2026-09-19
_why: This result inverts the programme's dev-box plan, so the two load-bearing arms were re-run BY HAND on the same harness rather than accepted. The agent has already self-corrected once in this package (a 3-step liveness probe reported a live tactical head as dark), which is a reason to check, not a reason to doubt.

arms.note: The MEMORY number reproduces to 3 decimals; the WALL-CLOCK does not, and that is expected and is itself the point -- a spilling configuration's step time is set by host paging and co-tenancy, not by the GPU. It is not a compute cost, so it is not reproducible as one.

verdict: CONFIRMED. The production resnet34 rig at batch 2 allocates 14.63 GB on an 8188 MiB card -- it pages to host RAM. resnet101 with frozen BN + leading-batch chunk checkpointing runs at 2.887 GB and 4.2-4.9 s/step.
_evidence_class: MEASURED (ours; two arms re-run on the agent's harness, GPU idle at 538 MiB)
